title: Test a batch: as many a's as b's
notes: The stack holds the surplus: a's while there have been more a's, b's while there have been more b's, and just $ when they are even. The batch checks words the machine should accept and words it should reject; ε is accepted because q1 accepts and nothing needs matching.
ops: start q0; accept q1; q0 eps, eps -> q1 $; q1 a, $ -> q2 a$; q1 b, $ -> q2 b$; q2 a, a -> q2 aa; q2 b, b -> q2 bb; q2 a, b -> q2 eps; q2 b, a -> q2 eps; q2 eps, $ -> q1 $
